title: Portfolio overview
description: Golden signals, traces, logs and monitoring-stack health for the portfolio app.

options.content:
## Portfolio · live production telemetry
Metrics, traces and logs from the app at **demo.portfolio.geoffgilchrist.com**, collected with OpenTelemetry and stored in Prometheus, Tempo and Loki running beside it on ECS Fargate. Click a dot on the latency graph to open that request's trace; every log line links to its trace too.

panels.title: Requests / sec
panels.description: All app requests per second (health checks excluded).

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95% of requests finish faster than this. Green under 300 ms.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status.

panels.title: Availability
panels.description: Non-5xx responses over the selected time range.

panels.title: Running tasks
panels.description: App containers currently reporting telemetry.

panels.title: Deployed version
panels.description: Git commit of the running image.

panels.title: Service level objective · 99.5% of requests succeed in under 250 ms
Objective
panels.description: SLO: 99.5% of requests return a non-5xx response in 250 ms or less. Defined in obs/config/prometheus/rules/slo.yml.

panels.title: Good requests (24h)
panels.description: Share of requests in the last 24 hours that met the objective (the SLI).

panels.title: Error budget left (24h)
panels.description: How much of the last 24 hours' 0.5% error budget is unspent. Below zero means the SLO was missed.

panels.title: Burn rate (1h)
panels.description: How fast the budget is being spent: 1x lasts exactly the SLO window; alerts fire at 6x (slow burn) and 14.4x (fast burn).

panels.title: Burn rate by window
panels.description: Multiwindow burn rates. A short and a long window must both exceed a threshold to alert, so alerts are fast but not jumpy.

panels.title: Active alerts
panels.description: Prometheus alert rules for the app and the monitoring stack (obs/config/prometheus/rules/alerts.yml). Email notifications come from CloudWatch alarms outside this stack.

panels.title: Requests by ECS task
panels.description: The load balancer spreads requests across the app tasks; each line is one Fargate task.

panels.title: Task CPU (share of reserved)
panels.description: CPU each Fargate task is using as a share of the CPU it reserved (app tasks: 0.5 vCPU; monitoring: 1 vCPU). Matches CloudWatch's ECS CPUUtilization.

panels.title: Task memory (share of reserved)
panels.description: Memory each task is using as a share of its reservation. An alert fires above 85%.

panels.title: Memory by container
panels.description: Every container in both services, including the OpenTelemetry agent sidecars and the Service Connect proxies ECS adds.

panels.title: Task network
panels.description: Bytes per second in (above the axis) and out (below) for each task.

panels.title: Requests by route
panels.description: Request rate per route.

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: Response time percentiles. Dots are exemplars: click one to open that request's trace.

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: How request durations are spread over time; brighter cells hold more requests. Each column counts exactly its own interval (at least a minute), so cells don't blur into their neighbours.

panels.title: Responses by status code
panels.description: 2xx success, 4xx client errors (e.g. missing pages), 5xx server errors.

panels.title: Load testing · real visitors vs synthetic load (k6)
Requests: real vs synthetic
panels.description: Real visitors next to load-test traffic. The headline stats and the SLO count both.

panels.title: p95 latency: real vs synthetic
panels.description: Real pages should stay fast while synthetic load asks for slow answers.

panels.title: Error rate: real vs synthetic
panels.description: Share of 5xx answers. Synthetic errors are requested by the test; real ones are not.

panels.title: Load-test requests by scenario
panels.description: Which k6 scenario is running (smoke, ramp, spike or soak, plus the ambient background traffic every demo session gets), counted by the app itself.

panels.title: Service map
panels.description: Built by Tempo from traces: who calls whom, with request rate and latency on each edge. 'user' stands for callers outside the traces (browsers via the load balancer).

panels.title: Recent traces
panels.description: Latest requests traced end to end. Click a trace ID to see its spans.

panels.title: App logs
panels.description: Structured logs from the app; lines written during a request carry its trace ID.

panels.title: Load balancer requests by target group
panels.description: Requests the ALB routed to each target group per minute: the app and Grafana.

panels.title: Load balancer response time (p95)
panels.description: Time from the ALB sending a request to a target until the response starts, as AWS measures it.

panels.title: Healthy targets
panels.description: Tasks passing ALB health checks per target group. The CloudWatch alarms watch these.

panels.title: ECS service CPU
panels.description: Average CPU of each ECS service as a share of its reserved CPU.

panels.title: ECS service memory
panels.description: Average memory of each ECS service as a share of its reserved memory.

panels.title: Load balancer errors
panels.description: Error responses counted by the load balancer.

panels.title: Component up
panels.description: Every monitoring component is scraped by Prometheus, including Prometheus itself.

panels.title: Telemetry flowing through the collector
panels.description: Items per second accepted by the OpenTelemetry Collector; anything refused is shown in red.

panels.title: Memory by component
panels.description: Resident memory of each monitoring process.

panels.title: Active series
panels.description: Time series held in Prometheus memory.

panels.title: Samples / sec
panels.description: Samples Prometheus is ingesting.

panels.title: Log lines / sec
panels.description: Log lines Loki is receiving.

panels.title: Spans / sec
panels.description: Spans Tempo is receiving.

list.name: Deploys
list.expr: label_replace((count by (service_version) (target_info{job="portfolio-app"}) unless count by (service_version) (target_info{job="portfolio-app"} offset 2m)) and on() (time() - process_start_time_seconds{job="prometheus"} > 180), "version", "$1", "service_version", "(.{7}).*")

list.name: Task starts
list.expr: label_replace((count by (aws_ecs_service_name, aws_ecs_task_id) (ecs_task_memory_reserved_MiB) unless count by (aws_ecs_service_name, aws_ecs_task_id) (ecs_task_memory_reserved_MiB offset 2m)) and on() (time() - process_start_time_seconds{job="prometheus"} > 180), "task", "$1", "aws_ecs_task_id", "(.{8}).*")
